title: International Property Mortgages
summary: Service page of Silver Oak Capital (London debt advisory) on international property mortgages: financing for the purchase or refinance of homes outside the borrower's home country. Per search summaries, the page explains what an international property mortgage is and who it suits; stresses that the process and outcome vary by country; frames the core decision as borrowing locally (in-country) versus using a bank with cross-border capabilities; targets second-home and investment buyers abroad, cross-border acquirers, borrowers refinancing overseas property and HNW families building multi-country portfolios; flags non-resident restrictions, notary involvement, different deposit rules, certification/translation delays and tighter AML checks (clear source-of-funds trail); and notes that some private banks can lend across borders for strong HNW profiles. No fees, LTVs, rates, loan sizes, timescales or process steps specific to this page were revealed by the snippets. Full page text was NOT retrieved: everything comes from search-engine snippets and the search tool's summaries.
